chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 465: Descent to the Yellow Corpse Sea & Great Destruction Spear
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen recovers and studies the Great Destruction Spear technique. Half-ancestors seal the area and descend into the corpse river seeking Eternal Light. Babura and others follow into the underground yellow corpse sea.
